---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change that adds capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What's frustrating today, or what's missing. Describe the pain, not the
solution.

## Proposal

What you'd like to see. If you already have a design in mind, sketch it
here — otherwise this can be a paragraph.

## Alternatives you considered

Other approaches, and why the proposal is better (or why none of the
alternatives worked).

## Impact

Who does this help — a specific persona, a specific customer situation,
a compliance need. If it's speculative, say so.

## Anything else

Prior art, related issues, links to writeups.
